about_the_game:
Magic Paint is a captivating pixel-art 2D side-scrolling meat pigeon game that brings players an exciting and varied gaming experience. [/p]

The wide variety of weapons in the game is a highlight. Players can collect a variety of weapons such as swords, guns, axes, etc., each with its own unique attack patterns and basic attributes. What's even more amazing is that players will be able to equip their weapons with accessories, and different combinations of accessories will make the weapons work very differently. For example, equipping a pistol with a silencer can improve the accuracy of shooting; Inlay the greatsword with rune gems to add an extra damage type. Discover and fight to collect rare accessories to create your own powerful weapon.
